Load hoopR NBA Stats rolling windows

Source: R/load_nba_stats_extra.R
load_nba_stats_rolling_windows.Rd

Loads the nba_stats_rolling_windows release: every shooter's rolling form over his last window_n field-goal attempts (metric = "fg_pct") and three-point attempts ("fg3_pct"), for window_n 50 and 200, computed from load_nba_stats_shots(). One row per player per window unit per window size. Windows count attempts, not games, and cross season boundaries: cur is the make rate over the last n attempts through the season, prev the window before it, season_start the window entering the season and career_baseline every attempt before cur's window (each NA rather than partial without a full window of history). delta_prev_rank is 1 for the biggest riser among qualified rows.

Usage

load_nba_stats_rolling_windows(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

The nba_stats_rolling_windows release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_stats_rolling_windows, published by https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data.

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit years – the season's START year (e.g. 2024 for the 2024-25 season). Published coverage starts at 1996 (1996-97). Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season.

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per entity per metric per window.

col_nametypesdescription
seasonintegerEND year of the NBA season (2025 = 2024-25), the asset's own stamp: one more than the seasons argument.
entity_typecharacterWhich aggregate the row is: "league" (every counted attempt that season), "team" or "player" on metric_curves; always "player" on rolling_windows.
entity_idcharacterstats.nba.com id of the entity as TEXT – the team_id on a team row, the person_id on a player row, NA on the league row.
entity_namecharacterLabel for the entity: the team tricode ("GSW") on a team row, the shooter's name as the pbp ships it on a player row; NA on the league row.
team_idcharacterstats.nba.com team id (e.g. 1610612737 = Atlanta Hawks).
metriccharacterWhat the row measures: "fg_pct_by_shot_distance" on metric_curves (field-goal percentage by shot distance in feet); "fg_pct" (window_unit "fga") or "fg3_pct" (window_unit "fg3a") on rolling_windows.
window_unitcharacterWhat the window counts: "fga" (every field-goal attempt) or "fg3a" (three-point attempts). Regular-season and playoff attempts only.
window_nintegerWindow size in attempts (50 or 200), not games.
curnumericMake rate over the player's last n attempts through the season (the current window).
prevnumericMake rate over the window_n attempts just before the current window; NA unless that whole window exists.
season_startnumericMake rate over the window_n attempts just before the season began (form entering the season); NA unless the career before the season holds a full window.
career_baselinenumericMake rate over every career attempt (since 1996-97) before the current window, earlier games of this season included; NA unless that history holds at least window_n attempts.
delta_prevnumericcur - prev; NA when either side is NA.
delta_seasonnumericcur - season_start; NA when either side is NA.
delta_careernumericcur - career_baseline; NA when either side is NA.
delta_prev_rankintegerRank of delta_prev within (window_unit, window_n, metric), 1 = biggest riser, ties share the lowest rank; NA unless the row is qualified and has a prev.
nintegerAttempts the current window averages: window_n, or fewer for a career shorter than the window.
qualifiedlogicalTRUE when n == window_n (a full window, not a short career). Filter on it before ranking or comparing players.
last_event_dateDateDate of the player's latest counted attempt through the season.
as_of_dateDateDate of the latest counted attempt league-wide that season: the date the windows are current through.
id_sourcecharacterNamespace of entity_id / team_id on this row – "nba_stats" here; the cross-league contract carries "espn", "gsis" and "wnba_stats" elsewhere.

See also

The publishing pipeline, https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data.

Other NBA Stats loader functions: load_nba_stats_coaches(), load_nba_stats_draft_combine, load_nba_stats_game_matchups(), load_nba_stats_hustle, load_nba_stats_injury_report(), load_nba_stats_leaguedash(), load_nba_stats_matchups(), load_nba_stats_metric_curves(), load_nba_stats_synergy()
